description:
About the company
 Our client is a real estate technology company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Design and build production AI backend systems, covering data ingestion, retrieval, model routing and output quality controls. Work as an early engineer on a small team, making architecture decisions and shipping systems alongside client-facing staff. Some travel to customer sites is part of the role.
 What you'll do
 - Build the core AI orchestration layer that powers client deployments, from document intake to answers grounded in cited sources.
 - Own a multi-provider model gateway that covers caching, request replay and evaluation-based routing to lower-cost models.
 - Partner with leadership and field engineers to spot reusable patterns and fold them into the shared platform.
 - Build extraction pipelines and semantic matching for messy unstructured documents, with controls against fabricated outputs.
 - Lead architecture of a shared structured-data and search service for multiple tenants, along with controls for privacy, policy enforcement, human review handoffs and audit trails.
 - Build reusable connectors to third-party enterprise software to speed up deployments.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - 5+ years of backend engineering experience.
 - Experience shipping LLM-based features to real production users, including evaluation, cost and latency trade-offs, and handling poor model outputs.
 - Track record of designing and building a platform or major system end to end, as an early or founding engineer, sole owner of a service, or on a small team.
 - Strong backend skills in APIs, data pipelines and cloud infrastructure.
 - Comfortable making architecture calls in ambiguous startup settings and working with sensitive data.
 - Able to spend up to 30% of working time on the road at customer locations.
 Bonus points
 - Experience with TypeScript and PostgreSQL is ideal.
 - Background in parsing text-heavy files with AI, linked-data modelling, or routing traffic across several language model providers.
 - Financial document literacy.
 - Fine-tuning or computer vision experience.
 - Prior work at a small, fast-moving young company, ideally in an early or founding engineering role.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 150,000 to 240,000 per year
 - Equity
 Location and work model
 - Chicago, IL, United States
 - Hybrid
 - Full-time
